# Coverage builds select rust-dev separately from the stable Rust toolchain

After the exact backout of the earlier generic-Rust change, this replacement assigns linux64-rust-dev and win64-rust-dev to the coverage build fetch lists and references those upstream tasks. Fixed accepted coverage configuration retains the selection. Stable Rust and other Rust tools remain separate; these declarations do not establish compiler compatibility, a resolved taskgraph or successful coverage execution.

Scope: taskcluster/ccov-rust-toolchain.
